# Hillsqr

> Hillsqr is an independent IT support and consulting business for small offices in Reading, Wokingham, Bracknell, Henley-on-Thames, Crowthorne and the wider Thames Valley, Berkshire, UK. Tagline: Your IT value partner.

Services: office IT support (desktops, laptops, Wi-Fi and networks, printers, Microsoft 365), IT consulting and solution architecture, web hosting and SEO improvement, software development and modernisation, Agile and DevOps coaching. On-site or remote.
